import os
import psycopg

dsn = os.environ.get("APP_DB_URL", "").strip()
assert dsn, "APP_DB_URL missing"
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute("DELETE FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings")
cur.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings")
remaining = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f"DELETE_OK remaining_rows={remaining}")

cur.close()
conn.close()
